rows.definition: Vulkan fused wrapper helper checking all selected weight-slot pointers have sufficient nominal resident buffer bytes while their live owners and command-stream lock are retained.
rows.distinction: These slots are expert weight bindings, unlike the scheduler Slot free/busy signal. The helper checks nominal bytes only and does not validate stale aliases, device generations, or dispatch-grid limits.

rows.definition: Pure bounded Q2_K token-panel geometry carrying output/input widths, exactly 2/4/8 rows, validated byte extents and the workgroup count for the three-int32 shader push ABI.
rows.distinction: An immutable launch geometry result, not a recorded Vulkan command buffer or a device qualification claim.

rows.definition: Pure planner that validates Q2_K matrix geometry, block divisibility, signed 32-bit byte bounds and exactly 2/4/8 token rows before returning V41Q2KTokenPanelPlan.
rows.distinction: Performs host arithmetic admission only; the returned plan holds geometry while provider capability and opt-in decide whether native execution is available.

rows.definition: Pure bounded Q3_K token-panel geometry carrying output/input widths, exactly 2/4/8 rows, 110-byte quantized block extents padded to four bytes, and workgroup count for the three-int32 shader push ABI.
rows.distinction: An immutable launch geometry result for Q3_K storage rather than Q2_K geometry or a recorded Vulkan command buffer; does not qualify native device execution.

rows.definition: Pure planner validating Q3_K matrix geometry, block divisibility, padded 110-byte block storage, signed 32-bit byte bounds and exactly 2/4/8 token rows before returning V41Q3KTokenPanelPlan.
rows.distinction: Host arithmetic admission for Q3_K storage; the result contains geometry while provider capability and opt-in independently control execution. Distinct from the Q2_K planner.

rows.definition: Pure lookup of a supplied CUDA weight-operation declaration table for an operation, exact storage/scale format and covered generic architecture; missing, duplicate, unknown or malformed rows fail closed.
rows.distinction: A source declaration lookup, not the actual backend capability advertised by Caps.FusedAttn, a linked-artifact census, device probe, model admission, numerical parity or hardware-performance witness.

rows.definition: Private dtype-only predicate for membership in the CUDA source-declared MatMul format table, preserving the existing nine accepted weight dtypes without adding architecture admission.
rows.distinction: A dtype-only source declaration membership test without target admission, unlike CUDADeviceOpSupported which checks a supplied operation/format table and generic architecture. Neither predicate is Caps.FusedAttn actual backend lowering capability, a linked-artifact census, model admission or hardware qualification.

rows.definition: CUDA device and launch-geometry eligibility check for fused Qwen attention postprocessing.
rows.distinction: Unlike attention dispatch or the fused enqueue function, this performs no allocation, enqueue, KV mutation or attention arithmetic; checks device zero, capture state, token bounds, threads, shared memory and grid limits.

rows.definition: CUDA F32 fused Q/K RMS normalization, partial RoPE and owned KV-tail append enqueue for Qwen sequence prefill.
rows.distinction: Unlike attention score computation or backend dispatch, processes projected Q/K/V using the fixed 24-query/4-KV-head 256-dimension contract. It validates live pointer extents and rejects overlap before the single fused kernel; does not publish Go KV lengths.

rows.definition: Mutex-held Go sequence owner for opt-in CUDA fused attention postprocessing and exact KV append publication.
rows.distinction: Unlike attention backend dispatch or the C enqueue primitive, validates tensor ownership and append frontier, owns query transient and error drain, and advances KV lengths only after successful enqueue. It never retries a selected failing operation over a partially written cache.

rows.definition: Mutex-held Go owner for fused resident F32 Q/K normalization, partial RoPE and KV append publication.
rows.distinction: Unlike attention implementation dispatch, validates panels and frontiers, invokes existing COW append admission, owns query transient and publishes three append lengths after successful checked recording. It is not the numerical kernel or C eligibility predicate; selected errors remain errors and never authorize replay.

rows.definition: Mutation-free C eligibility predicate for the specific Vulkan fused attention postprocess path.
rows.distinction: Unlike attention implementation dispatch, evaluates ABI-qualified pipeline availability, grouped-head/rotary/numeric bounds, signed-index extents and workgroup geometry. It does not select a broader attention algorithm or record commands.

rows.definition: Checked C Vulkan command-recording boundary for fused Q/K normalization, partial RoPE and KV-tail outputs.
rows.distinction: Unlike attention implementation dispatch, validates submission state, buffer extents and nonaliasing, selects scalar/table RoPE input, constructs the push ABI and records the postprocess dispatch. It does not own Go COW/frontier publication or attention score computation. Unlike the similarly named CUDA F32 enqueue boundary, this operates on Vulkan Buffer allocation identity and records through the Vulkan batch dispatcher with scalar/table RoPE; it does not use CUDA pointer attributes or CUDA streams.

rows.definition: Mutex-held Vulkan Go owner consuming interleaved per-head Q/G F32 panels and publishing separately owned rotated query, unchanged gate and KV append outputs.
rows.distinction: Unlike the split-Q postprocess owner, consumes doubled-width QG and owns an additional gate transient. Unlike attention implementation dispatch, owns specific tensor/frontier/COW admission and selected-error lifecycle; selected errors never authorize replay.

rows.definition: Mutation-free eligibility predicate for Vulkan fused interleaved-QG postprocessing.
rows.distinction: Unlike split-Q postprocess eligibility, additionally preserves doubled QG signed-index limits and the original split flattened-grid admission. Requires both QG and predecessor availability; unlike general attention implementation dispatch, records no commands and selects no attention score algorithm.

rows.definition: Checked Vulkan command-recording boundary for direct interleaved QG consumption, Q/K normalization, partial RoPE, unchanged gate extraction and three KV-tail outputs.
rows.distinction: Unlike split-Q postprocess recording, uses eleven descriptors, independent gate output, doubled QG input extent and five output nonalias checks. Copies gate unchanged, not sigmoid or gate application; owns recording checks, not Go cache lengths or attention score dispatch.

rows.definition: CUDA device attention entrypoint reading F16 or BF16 position-major attended KV planes with F32 queries and online-softmax accumulators.
rows.distinction: Unlike fak_qwen35_attention_postprocess_f32, which normalizes and rotates projection rows while writing F32 KV, this entry reads already populated typed KV and produces grouped causal attention output; it does not mutate cache rows or normalize projections.

rows.definition: Immutable checked per-half byte capacities for a Qwen CUDA layer-sequence compensated split loan, with independent maximum weight-half and activation-half sizes. When a nonzero loan is active, capacity is reserved for two weight buffers and two activation buffers within one private loan.
rows.distinction: Unlike V41Q2KTokenPanelPlan, this result describes compensated split scratch half capacities, not token-panel launch geometry. It carries no device pointers, ownership, scheduling, or route policy and is not a total peak-VRAM bound; ordinary activations, KV, noncompensated arms, and vocabulary heads are outside this capacity pair.

rows.definition: Pure geometry preflight that computes the checked weight-half and activation-half capacities for an eligible Qwen CUDA compensated layer-sequence split loan from the existing P >= 128 dispatch predicates and locked Q4-arm snapshot. It validates dimensions and byte overflow, ignores irrelevant Q4 errors, and returns zero capacities when no eligible layer projection exists.
rows.distinction: Unlike PlanV41Q2KTokenPanel, this function computes compensated split scratch capacities, not token-panel launch geometry. Unlike cudaSequenceSplitScratchPlan, it is the pure constructor rather than the immutable result. It allocates no device memory, performs no fence, retirement or dispatch, and selects no new kernel policy. Vocabulary heads are excluded; the all-row head runs after checked loan retirement.

rows.definition: Checked representation metadata for canonical Qwen GDN QKV or Z weights: admitted Q4_K/Q6_K dtype, exact matrix rows and columns, block size and raw byte extent for shared use by loading and estimation; consumer wiring is separate.
rows.distinction: Unlike V41Q2KTokenPanelPlan, this describes a canonical QKV/Z weight representation rather than token-panel dispatch geometry. Unlike cudaSequenceSplitScratchPlan, it describes raw weight bytes rather than temporary compensated-split capacities. It does not establish tensor role, row normalization, device residency, current health, graph legality or permission to execute.

rows.definition: Versioned backend source declaration that the existing whole-GDN decode and sequence implementations understand canonical row-major block-256 Q4_K or Q6_K QKV/Z weights with F32 mutable state.
rows.distinction: Unlike Qwen35GDNPackedInputPlan, this declares an implementation contract rather than geometry or raw bytes. The declaration alone does not enable loading: explicit request controls, exact operation identities and actual independent dtype probes must resolve a per-load policy. It promises no graph capture, device health or measured hardware result.

rows.definition: Immutable per-load Q4_K/Q6_K admission decision resolved from explicit enable and force-off controls, the versioned whole-GDN implementation contract and actual backend residency/upload/dtype probes. Its zero value admits no packed GDN inputs.
rows.distinction: Unlike Qwen35GDNPackedInputCapability, this is the resolved decision rather than a backend declaration. Unlike Qwen35GDNPackedInputPlan, it selects admissible representations rather than calculating one tensor extent. It cannot establish current device health, memory capacity, canonical row identity, whole-operation validity or graph legality; capture remains refused.

rows.definition: Resolver that honors default-off and both force-off controls, checks actual whole-GDN decode and sequence method/path contracts, validates the versioned declaration and probes each admitted resident dtype before returning a copied per-load policy or typed refusal.
rows.distinction: Unlike Qwen35GDNPackedInputPolicy, this is the validating constructor rather than the immutable result. Unlike Qwen35GDNPackedInputCapability, it combines explicit request and actual probes instead of accepting a declaration alone. It reads no environment, makes no tensor upload, device allocation or model-operation call and never admits packed graph capture.

rows.definition: Generation-bound canonical-row relocation map with copied per-layer rotary contracts for complete-image eager FP8 KV eviction.
rows.distinction: This is retained mutable-KV row geometry, not Qwen35GDNPackedInputPlan static weight storage or ctxplan.PlanEviction survival-class token-budget selection. A mapping does not authorize stale owner use or graph replay.

rows.definition: Constructs a canonical-row FP8 eviction mapping from the current owner generation, row range and copied per-layer rotary contracts without device effects.
rows.distinction: This is the planner that returns kvFP8EvictionPlan, not the returned mapping or its eager execution. It plans complete-image row relocation, not survival-class token-budget selection, and does not establish caller lifetime or hardware qualification.

rows.definition: Eviction-family view of the same kvFP8EvictionPlan symbol: an owner-generation-bound row relocation descriptor retaining exact per-layer rotary contracts for complete-image replacement.
rows.distinction: This cross-indexes the plan-family descriptor rather than defining a second implementation. It carries the eviction mapping but neither chooses a survival-class token budget nor executes the planner or replacement.

rows.definition: Eviction-family view of the same planEvict method: validates the current complete-image row relocation contract and constructs its generation-bound mapping without device effects.
rows.distinction: This is the same planner indexed in the plan family, not a second operation. It constructs the descriptor but does not apply it, mutate device planes or choose a survival-class token budget.

rows.definition: Complete-image eager FP8 eviction entry that constructs a current-owner canonical-row plan and delegates its checked execution to kvFP8ApplyEvictionEager.
rows.distinction: This combines planning and application, unlike planEvict alone or an already prepared descriptor. It is internal orchestration rather than public precision selection, in-place compaction, graph replay or measured performance.

rows.definition: Executes a prepared generation-bound FP8 eviction mapping through disjoint all-layer staging, exact retained-row copies, bounded suffix rerotation, quantization and checked completion before publication.
rows.distinction: This consumes an existing mapping, whereas kvFP8EvictEager also plans it and planEvict only constructs it. It does not compact in place, activate a serving constructor or qualify graph replay, device lifetime or performance.

rows.definition: Private retained F32 query owner, exact byte extent and backend/device metadata for one staged FP8 attention operation.
rows.distinction: Unlike fcuda_kv_attention_typed, this value neither executes attention nor owns the staged KV image; it retains the source query and does not prove numerical validity or expose a public Tensor.

rows.definition: Ephemeral F32 output allocation view and cumulative numerical-status allocation scoped to the checked staged-attention use callback.
rows.distinction: Unlike the retained input kvFP8AttentionQuery, this borrowed view represents the fresh output and status used inside the callback; it is not an owning public Buffer, a returned Tensor or an attention executor.

rows.definition: Retention holder for prior raw/key/value input roots, the query owner and fresh output allocation across uncertain staged FP8 attention work.
rows.distinction: Unlike the query or output views, this holder keeps their underlying roots reachable before allocation or submission and through abnormal control transfer; it is not a cache, reusable pool, checked completion receipt or numerical-validity claim.

rows.definition: Checked F32 query/output byte-extent calculation for the bounded four-KV-head, head-dimension-256 staged FP8 attention geometry.
rows.distinction: Unlike the retained query/output/roots values and attention entrypoints, this helper performs only bounded dimension and integer-overflow checks; it neither allocates memory nor reserves global capacity or establishes device support.

rows.definition: Uncalled qualification-only typed query gate and binding of the retained staged-attention helper to the private native FP8 attention wrapper under existing ForwardExecutionOwner and cudaMu serialization.
rows.distinction: Unlike the query/output metadata and the native wrapper alone, this adapter validates Tensor provenance and binds checked host lifecycle callbacks; it is not a public model or serving route, graph capture path or default attention dispatch.

rows.definition: Private native five-plane, query, output and status provenance/extent/alias gate around the existing scalar FP8 attention submission, returning a selected diagnostic receipt.
rows.distinction: Unlike the qualification-only typed adapter and the F16/BF16 fcuda_kv_attention_typed entry, this wrapper admits private FP8 planes and fresh output; zero status means accepted submission only, not checked completion, numerical validity, publication or H200 qualification.
